title: Your profile
focus: The profile page and what it holds
content:
## Open it

Use the badge in the top-right corner. Its menu holds **Profile settings**, **Switch course**, **Documentation** and **Log out**.

## Personal information

You can set a first and last name. Both are optional. The site greets you by first name. On shared boards your name shows as the first name and the last initial, such as *Ana L.*.

Your e-mail address shows as read-only. It is what you sign in with, and it stays as it is.

The app can be shown in six languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Chinese. Pick one here. It saves at once.

Names and language save as you edit. There is no Save button.

## Account

**Change password** asks for your current password and the new one twice. The new one needs at least 8 characters. **Sign out everywhere else** ends every other session of your account.

If you forget your password, ask the owner. They can set a temporary password for you. Skrongle sends no e-mail.

vocabulary.meaning: the page with your name, language and password
a sign-in on one browser or device
a password the owner sets for you to use once

quiz.prompt: At least how many characters must a new password have?
quiz.explanation: A password needs at least 8 characters.
hints: It is a number between five and ten.

quiz.prompt: You forgot your password. What do you do?
options: Ask the owner for a temporary password
quiz.correct_answer: Ask the owner for a temporary password
quiz.explanation: Skrongle sends no e-mail. The owner sets a temporary password.

quiz.prompt: You can change the e-mail address from the profile page.
quiz.explanation: The address shows read-only and stays fixed.
hints: It is what you sign in with.

quiz.prompt: How does a shared board show your name?
The profile has a Save button for names and language.
hints: The page saves as you go.

sorts.title: Can you change it on the profile?
sorts.why: The address is fixed. Names, language and password can change.
